ticket.title: Export invoices as CSV
ticket.description: Operators export the invoice list as CSV from the invoice page.

comments.body:
## Qualification handoff

### Acceptance

- **AC-1** As an operator, I want an Export CSV button on the invoice list, so that I can download the list as shown.
- **AC-2** As an accountant, I want number, date, customer and total of every invoice of the selected period in the CSV, so that accounting can import it.
- **AC-3** The change passes every matching bb-phase-validate row of WORKFLOW.md.

Tally: 3 passed, 0 rewritten.

### Handoff metadata

- `recipe`: probe
- `ticket_type`: feature
- `reproduction`: not_required
- `scenario_required`: false
- `test_as`: no login needed
- prior art: negative
- `handoff_version`: 1
- `provenance`: fixture-revision-1

# Spec

Approval: the user agreed this spec.

Export the invoice list as CSV from the invoice page: one row per invoice, columns number, date, customer, total.

# Plan

Approval: the user agreed it.

1. Add the Export CSV button to src/invoices/list.ts.
2. Write the invoice rows as CSV.
3. Test both in test/invoices.test.ts.

# Test plan

Approval: the user agreed it.

| # | Covers | Command |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | AC-1, AC-2 | `npm test -- test/invoices.test.ts` |
| P1 | AC-3 | `npm test` |
